messages.subject: For Olayan Alwetaid | Digital infrastructure, Saudi transformation and government partnerships
messages.body:
Dear stc Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Olayan Mohammed Alwetaid, Group Chief Executive Officer.

stc's role in Saudi Arabia's digital transformation places government relationships, strategic investment, AI-enabled infrastructure and institutional partnerships at the center of execution. Those priorities align strongly with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and emerging-market execution might support stc's growth priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to stc group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
